headline: HCA Healthcare (HCA) Faces Third Straight Year Of Mission Health Compliance Concerns
summary: Independent monitors flagged recurring non-compliance issues tied to HCA Healthcare's acquisition of Mission Health for a third consecutive year. Concerns include discontinued industrial rehabilitation services, reduced access to services at Mission Hospital and affiliated facilities, and a Medicare termination notice.
